cases.title: Canonical Qoralo benchmark (v2)
cases.text: Welcome to our small studio, where curious minds unpack one surprising idea at a time. Today, we explore why familiar voices build trust, how thoughtful pauses shape meaning, and what makes a conversation feel genuinely alive.

cases.title: Conversational podcast excerpt
cases.text: Welcome back. Have you ever noticed how a tiny pause can change a whole conversation? I used to think a good answer had to arrive immediately. Then a friend asked me to wait, just for a moment, before replying. The silence felt awkward at first, but it gave us both room to think. Today, let's try that experiment together.
